descriptions.d24i_lua_set_item_80103090: Lua binding: expects one string argument naming a setting, looks up its value handle (0x800fc1b0), requires value kind 5 (virtual +24), pops the argument and passes the resolved item (0x801797b4) to the object at +64 through its virtual +32; each failure reports through 0x801022ec with its message, pops the argument and returns 0, success returns 1.
